appraisal_events.evidence: j'ai pensé depuis que si M. Vinteuil avait pu assister à cette scène, il n'eût peut-être pas encore perdu sa foi dans le bon cœur de sa fille, et peut-être même n'eût-il pas eu en cela tout à fait tort... Les sadiques de l'espèce de Mlle Vinteuil sont des êtres si purement sentimentaux, si naturellement vertueux que même le plaisir sensuel leur paraît quelque chose de mauvais.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator extensively reconsiders Mlle Vinteuil, arguing at length that beneath the performed cruelty she is fundamentally tender and virtuous, only theatrically borrowing the persona of wickedness she cannot truly inhabit -- a substantial, narrator-endorsed softening of the harsh verdict implied by the scene just witnessed, though the passage closes by naming a quieter, more permanent cruelty (indifference to the suffering one causes) as her real fault.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's extended, endorsed analysis reframes her as essentially good-hearted and only superficially wicked, a real elevation relative to the raw cruelty just witnessed, even as a residual culpability is affirmed at the close.

ambiguities: The narrator's rehabilitation of Mlle Vinteuil is qualified by a closing indictment of a subtler, more permanent cruelty (indifference to suffering caused), so her net local standing is genuinely mixed rather than simply raised.
